name: Royal.io
rootCause: Zero-amount ERC1155 batch transfer inflated Royal LDA tier balance. Lost: 261,162.93 USDC

descriptions.text: Zero-amount ERC1155 batch transfer inflated Royal LDA tier balance. Lost: 261,162.93 USDC

A legacy royalties contract (Royal1155LD) associated with Royal.io on Polygon was exploited due to a logic flaw in reward/pro-rata royalty accounting. The attacker used a flash loan and 100 zero-value ERC1155 transfers to manipulate the beforeLdaTransfer function, inflating balances and withdrawing ~$263K USDC.

On June 23, 2026, Royal.io’s legacy Polygon royalties contract was exploited via a zero-amount ERC1155 batch transfer that inflated tier accounting, causing an unauthorized USDC withdrawal of about $261,000. The root cause was inconsistent custom share accounting in the Royal1155LDA contract. The Royal1155LDA contract failed to check and process nonzero transfer amounts in its custom ownership accounting hook. Zero-amount batch transfers could incorrectly increment the recipient's tier balance, inflating pro-rata royalty entitlement without real ERC1155 ownership.
